premise: Around 1000, at a fictional monastery in southern England. A village disputes its winter grain obligation. Investigate through manuscripts, witnesses and the delivery route; restrained, ambiguous folk horror.

skills.name: Read Write Latin
skills.use: Read the wording of a dated obligation; script and language remain separate from spoken fluency.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

skills.name: Track
skills.use: Compare cart and foot trails on a plausible surface; a trail alone does not identify motive.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

skills.name: Library Use
skills.use: Find a relevant document with permission; this is not automatic access to a locked archive.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

skills.name: Persuade
skills.use: Negotiate a specific concession from a willing interlocutor; cannot dictate beliefs.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

items.name: Writing kit
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Prepare a witnessed handwritten copy after access is granted.
items.effect: Preserves the observed wording for comparison; no bonus die or automatic translation.
items.limits: One kit; ink and writing surface sufficient for three short copies by explicit allocation.
items.upkeep: Mark each copy; after three, request supplies from the custodian.
items.substitute: Ask a literate custodian to read aloud; record oral testimony.

items.name: Measuring cord
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Lay beside visible wheel impressions with the guide.
items.effect: Compare widths at two locations; agreement is supporting evidence, not proof of identity.
items.limits: One cord, no climbing or load-bearing rating supplied.
items.upkeep: Dry and return it; if lost, use counted paces with lower precision.
items.substitute: Compare the route with a local cart driver.

items.name: Host introduction token
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Present the fictional steward's marked token to request a hearing.
items.effect: Establishes who sent the party; the recipient still decides access.
items.limits: One loaned token, no universal legal or religious authority.
items.upkeep: Return at departure; loss can be explained by the steward in person.
